audit_items.proof_trace: Spec requires computing epoch ONCE from pre-state (line 8334: epoch = electra.get_current_epoch(pre)), but implementation calls beaconState.Slot() twice (L108 for proposer lookahead, L120 for Fork.Epoch). Each Slot() call acquires/releases a read lock independently (state-native/getters_misc.go:41-44), creating a TOCTOU window where concurrent SetSlot() could cause inconsistent epoch values.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If state is shared between goroutines during upgrade (e.g., cached globally), an attacker with concurrent access could call SetSlot() between L108 and L120 reads, causing ProposerLookahead and Fork.Epoch to use different slot values, violating the spec requirement that all post-state fields derive from the same pre-state snapshot.
